0.name: TEXT_REGYOK6TULIYOLLAL_00864_HAKEELJA_000_000
0.description: Welcome to Tuliyollal! You're the, ah...<hex:021A020203>adventurer<hex:021A020103> Wuk Lamat recruited to her entourage, yes? If there's anything you wish to know, I am at your service.

3.name: TEXT_REGYOK6TULIYOLLAL_00864_A1_000_002
3.description: What manner of place is this?

5.name: TEXT_REGYOK6TULIYOLLAL_00864_HAKEELJA_000_010
5.description: Is it not obvious at a glance? Then again, perhaps an Eorzean would be unfamiliar with Mamool Ja culture... I am of the Boonewa tribe, and like most of my kin, I specialize in matters of the arcane.

6.name: TEXT_REGYOK6TULIYOLLAL_00864_HAKEELJA_000_011
6.description: As soon as I came of age, I left my hometown of Mamook and journeyed all across Tural to hone my skills. It gave me some much-needed perspective on the world around me.

7.name: TEXT_REGYOK6TULIYOLLAL_00864_HAKEELJA_000_012
7.description: I considered traveling to Eorzea next, but I took quite a liking to Tuliyollal, and so I plan to remain to make use of my magicks here.

8.name: TEXT_REGYOK6TULIYOLLAL_00864_HAKEELJA_000_020
8.description: Tuliyollal is the beating heart of Tural that the Dawnservant would call home.

9.name: TEXT_REGYOK6TULIYOLLAL_00864_HAKEELJA_000_021
9.description: It got its start about eighty years ago, when the newly crowned Dawnservant decided to build a town centered on the Yok Huy temple ruins.

10.name: TEXT_REGYOK6TULIYOLLAL_00864_HAKEELJA_000_022
10.description: By implementing a medley of techniques from all different Turali cultures, the Tuliyollal style of architecture was born! Beautiful, isn't it?

11.name: TEXT_REGYOK6TULIYOLLAL_00864_HAKEELJA_000_030
11.description: By the way, have you heard that Gulool Ja Ja is stepping down as Dawnservant? I suppose he just wants to live out his final years in peace. In any case, I hope you're excited for the ascension ceremony─it ought to be quite the spectacle!

12.name: TEXT_REGYOK6TULIYOLLAL_00864_HAKEELJA_000_040
12.description: More importantly, did you attend the ascension ceremony? As a proud citizen of Tuliyollal, I couldn't be happier to have Koana and Wuk Lamat as our new Vows of Reason and Resolve!

13.name: TEXT_REGYOK6TULIYOLLAL_00864_HAKEELJA_000_050
13.description: Now if only there was something we could do about those disgusting metal monsters. The audacity of them to trample all over our proud history!

14.name: TEXT_REGYOK6TULIYOLLAL_00864_HAKEELJA_000_060
14.description: It was that same unity across all cultures that brought us together to protect it. I've never been prouder to call Tuliyollal home!

15.name: TEXT_REGYOK6TULIYOLLAL_00864_HAKEELJA_000_070
15.description: And when Wuk Lamat returned home victorious, the myriad communities of Tuliyollal were right here to welcome her. Whatever problems are still ahead of us, I know we'll be in good hands─hers <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> Koana's!
